description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Wathupitiya, Nivithigala   D/S Division, Rathnapura   District - Cad. Map No. 620401
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land administrative matters present.
